maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 01 · Prayers from a Repentant Heart

nodeData.topic: Day 01 · Prayers from a Repentant Heart
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.1-2 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Opening the Purushottama month series, Maharaj presents Brahma's prayers as the offering of one who has truly repented, and teaches us to say sorry and to pray from the heart. He paints Krishna as the proud village cowherd boy, not the majestic Narayana, and shows that even Brahma cannot fathom him, so speculation is like beating empty husks while surrender simply means following. In the questions he speaks on doing a few vows with heart, a disturbed mind, sincere prayer, deepening repentance and suffering as purification. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: For the Purushottama month Maharaj takes up Brahma's prayers to Krishna in Srimad-Bhagavatam 10.14. They show Brahma keeping reverence while immersed in sweetness.

Brahma's prayers do not come from pride but from deep realisation. Maharaj says this is how to deal with Krishna: everything from the heart, or the offering should not be made at all.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:30 (auto-transcript): “sweetness the grammar offered these prayers but not out of arrogance so it is he offered this prayer from deep innovation deep realization actually that is what it is to be dealing with Krishna everything should be done right from the heart if it is not what offering…”

Introducing the evening's writing exercise, Maharaj stresses that Brahma was not speaking intellectually but sharing his devotional feelings; our own prayers should flow the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:41 (auto-transcript): “it's not an intellectual thing this is the things of devotion our our feeling we're expressing to Lord Krishna. That is the move Lord Brahma offered his prayer. He was not just intellectually speaking. He was sharing his devotional feelings to Krishna. That is how we should…”

Maharaj jokes that our grandfather Brahma started the hijacking business when he stole Krishna's cowherd friends and calves for a year.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:17 (auto-transcript): “your friend tell your question we should know that lord burma was the first person who hijacked who started the hijacking business he is our grandfather so everything started he kidnapped the hijacked that king krishna's cow head boys and krishna's calves for the period of…”

It was an offence, yet it let Krishna fulfil the desire of the elderly gopis who longed to have him as their own son. Krishna knew this and allowed Brahma to facilitate it.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:52 (auto-transcript): “It may be considered an offense that Lord Brahma did, but we can learn some of it, that although he did this, Lord Brahma gave Lord Krishna the opportunity to fulfill his desires of the better basis, especially the elderly groupies who wanted Krishna also as their son.…”

Taking away the boys and calves made Krishna expand himself as all of them, and so the elders' wish was fulfilled. Maharaj also contrasts this with Indra's offence and the gopis' pain over Krishna's soft feet in the forest.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:48 (auto-transcript): “Still, taking away, hijacking the cup of Krishna expanded himself. So in this way, Lord Brahma gave Krishna's chance to fulfill the desire of the elderly God. we can learn and also we can see lord brahma's humility offering his prayers many devotees”

Many devotees do not know how to say sorry. Because we never accept that we did wrong, even when we see someone hurt, the word will not come out.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:32 (auto-transcript): “we can learn and also we can see lord brahma's humility offering his prayers many devotees many devotees does not know how to say sorry doesn't know how to say sorry and because we have never accepted that we have done something wrong even when we are seeing that the other”

Brahma repented deeply for his offence, and his prayers for mercy come out of that repentance. Maharaj says this attitude is what makes one successful and great.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:30 (auto-transcript): “therefore we cannot say sorry but when we look at brahma's life the brahma repented from and offense to christian he deeply repented from the core of his heart he deeply repented and from that repentance he's offering dutiful prayers to obtain his mercy so it's very important…”

Repentance is a powerful fire. Brahma's so-called knowledge was burnt and purified by it, and only then could he see who Krishna really is and sing differently. — “Repentance burns all misgivings”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:51 (auto-transcript): “That potency is repentance, repentance is fire, fire, powerful fire that burns all misgivings. Repentance burns all misgivings, all repentance. So Lord Brahma burns off his offence by, therefore, from pure situation that pure, from this prayer,”
Brahma opens by declaring Krishna the only one worth worshipping and describes his cowherd form in detail.

Brahma sets aside the demigods and other objects of worship: only Krishna is to be worshipped, and he offers his prayer simply to please him.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:59 (auto-transcript): “camera drama is describing what he said my dear you are the only worshiping person compared to other personalities who are worshiping seven primordial Shiva, Indraganese and all other demigod culture worshipers, so Brahma said all those are nonsense. The only person to…”

Krishna is a person, so Maharaj asks us not just to hear the description but to let the camera of our mind take the picture — his colour, his garment, his ornaments.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:46 (auto-transcript): “that is krishna's call so krishna is a person so this is the picture we should put in our mind if you see this in our mind don't just hear something you should place this in the mind in the in the camera of our mind let this camera pick krishna is what blue like a new cloud…”

Mother Yasoda dresses Krishna in jewels, but in the forest he decorates himself with leaves, flowers and minerals. Maharaj asks: can you compare leaves to diamonds? For Brahma they are more valuable than all his wealth.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:57 (auto-transcript): “Krishna would remove all these things when they go to the forest and he would decorate the same with natural minerals in the forest. Leaves. Forest flowers. Can you imagine? Leaves. You compare leaves to diamond? Diamond? Leaves? The diamond? The internet is not working. We…”

Brahma is not a poet sitting down to imagine. Like a painter or sculptor working from the subject in front of him, he describes the Krishna he sees standing there.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:33 (auto-transcript): “so the burner is able to see the potency or or the penance bend of the reactions so he not sink is clearly and it is not like the drummer is sitting down like a poet sitting down meditate and write something the grandma is sink Krishna standing and it perfectly describing…”

Maharaj asks the class to close their eyes and see Krishna with stick, horn and flute — then asks whether Narayana carries such things. No: Narayana is a king and does not dance in public.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:45 (auto-transcript): “toe and fro and buffalo horn the flute and this equipment what is the equipment of Narayan What is Narayan? Narayan has a stick? No, because he's a card and a ball. Narayan has flute? No, because he's not a dancer. He's a king, he cannot dance in the public. He cannot even…”

Narayana is a city man; Krishna is a village boy and is not ashamed of his occupation, even holding food in his hand like an unpolished boy. — “He's a village boy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 81:03 (auto-transcript): “Darian is a city man. But Krishna is not a city boy. He's a village boy. And he's very proud of that. shame of his occupation, including his selling business. It's not a shame. When Lord Brahma was praying to Krishna and glorified Lord Krishna like this, so that Bhishnana…”

Drawing on an acarya who enters Krishna's mind, Maharaj voices Krishna's replies: I have no mystic power, I am just a small boy who keeps cows and does not know proper conduct — it was you who bewildered me while I searched for my calves and friends.

🎙 Maharaj at 81:40 (auto-transcript): “christmas mind so bishnana chakras is there oh brahma you are a master of mystic powers how can you how can you offer me prayers to a great personality how can you offer me prayer i should offer prayers to you ishwara correct how can you no the brahma is the brahma is talking…”
Brahma admits that no one, himself included, can measure the potency of Krishna's form, much less his inner happiness.

If the first created being cannot understand, who else can? All later philosophers came after Brahma, and even their Vedic knowledge came through him, from Krishna via Sarasvati. — “If we're intelligent, we should hear Brahma.”

🎙 Maharaj at 87:13 (auto-transcript): “the first person in this so if he doesn't know who else can who else this lesson we should take All the philosophers, all the philosophers we have, they came after the Brahma. So the Brahma is describing what Krishna looks like. And other philosophers are giving a different…”

Brahma speaks of the Krishna standing face to face with him, the way one describes the hair and eyes of a person in front of you — very different from talking about imagined things.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:30 (auto-transcript): “He's not talking about something utopian. He's talking about something he's seeing. He's seeing Krishna standing before him directly, face to face. He's talking about something he's seeing. If I'm describing you writing the style of your head, your eyes, your face, and…”

children.topic: A controlled mind is not enough
children.note:
Even with his mind withdrawn from matter, Brahma cannot understand Krishna; he sees him only by Krishna's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 90:08 (auto-transcript): “Although my mind is controlled, still I cannot understand. This word program. He said my mind is free from karma not free from malice yet. They will not complete Only when one is free from karma again yoga then won't be able to enter into mysteries”
These verses contrast hearing about Krishna, which conquers even the unconquerable Lord, with the fruitless labour of speculation.
Maharaj cites the Gita: only by undivided devotion can Krishna be known as he is and seen directly. Those who reject bhakti for other paths get only trouble.
Once the rice is taken out, beating the husk gives nothing but fatigue. So it is with karma, jnana and yoga without bhakti.

Maharaj's modern version: chewing gum long after the taste is gone — just plastic, chewing and chewing. Our sufferings in material life are equally superfluous.

🎙 Maharaj at 95:44 (auto-transcript): “they stick right at that time you see many women they chew chewing gum because it's chewing gum chewing chewing gum and they chew the gum and the juice is already out when you keep chewing it what do you get what do you get There's nothing there, just the plastic, you're…”
Brahma tells how yogis of the past came to bhakti by offering their efforts to hearing and chanting, and so understood surrender.

After many years we are still not surrendered, and that is why we cannot follow. Maharaj says it is that simple. — “Surrender means we follow. Not surrender means no follow.”

🎙 Maharaj at 98:20 (auto-transcript): “Many years, you are not surrendered. Therefore, we cannot follow. Surrender means we follow. Not surrender means no follow. That's all. Nothing more than that. How many times do I say more? Do you mind? Actually, Guruji, we have 20 more minutes with the question and answers.…”
Closing for time, Maharaj notes Brahma's point that even realising the impersonal aspect requires first purifying mind and senses — so the intelligent will listen to Brahma.

After a directed free-writing exercise led by the hosts, devotees ask five questions.

🎙 Maharaj at 117:35 (auto-transcript): “So we are welcoming all the devotees who would have any questions or comments that they would like to share. So we have 10 minutes, 10 to 12 minutes for this, after which we will be proceeding towards the Yugalarati. So devotees may either raise their hands on Zoom or type in…”

children.topic: Q1 · Can't connect with every vow
children.note:
A devotee cannot put her heart equally into all the Purushottama month practices. Should she do them all or focus on a few?

🎙 Maharaj at 118:04 (auto-transcript): “my question is out of lot of activities we are supposed to do in Prashatamant I cannot connect with every activities equally like it is said that we should read chapter 15 of bhagavad-gita and we should read uh jagandath ashtakam and all those things so i cannot properly…”

children.topic: Do what you can with heart
children.note:
All are recommended, but do the ones you can do nicely — even one item done with heart pleases Krishna, just as Brahma's prayer came naturally from his heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 119:12 (auto-transcript): “nicely it's not necessary to do everything right because it is necessary that is what is mentioned but since you cannot handle that do what you can handle they are all necessary that's why I can do it it's not that a time is not there I can do it but I am not able to connect…”

Material problems keep haunting a devotee; she can neither solve them nor absorb her mind in Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 120:40 (auto-transcript): “so i just wanted to ask that sometimes i have a lot of problems like a lot of material problems and i don't feel like thinking about it so i'm trying to absorb myself in krishna but still those things haunting me and sometimes I'm feeling oh I'm acting like a skippist and so…”

The mind has taken that picture and will hold it for a while; that is how the mind works. Pray to Krishna to take care of the disturbance and wait — it will go.

🎙 Maharaj at 124:05 (auto-transcript): “Because we are absorbing our mind too much on it, so we are talking about putting Krishna in the camera of our mind. So when our mind has captured that problem, it will take some time before it will go. Because that is how the mind works, so how we are in a certain month, so…”

A question from the chat: is it all right that we sometimes pray to Krishna immaturely?

🎙 Maharaj at 125:25 (auto-transcript): “There's a question in the chat box from Aradhyamata Ji. Mataji is asking, Hare Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble obeisances. Sometimes we pray to Krishna very immaturely. Is that okay? We pray to Krishna immaturely. Yes. It is not okay. Of course, Krishna will hear,…”

Krishna will hear, but it is not okay. Maharaj once admired a friend absorbed in prayer, only to learn he was just copying what others did. Brahma was not flattering Krishna; if we pray, we should be serious, or save everyone's time. — “We pray nicely and sincere.”

🎙 Maharaj at 126:23 (auto-transcript): “One day I saw one friend was praying seriously to the dead. I was very impressed. I was very moved. I was feeling bad. I don't pray like this. So let me ask him, so I can maintain the same mood. I said, my friend, what were you, how were you praying? I saw you were very…”

A devotee feels sorry after mistakes but is slow to make amends. How can repentance go deeper?

🎙 Maharaj at 128:11 (auto-transcript): “My question is, as we heard the potency of repentance in this data, so my question is how to increase the depth of our repentance what i observe many times i am having that feeling of repentance after this mistake but i am slow in taking the action of repentance the action of…”

Constantly check how we are doing; if we are not as happy as we should be, something is wrong. As conditioned souls we cannot avoid offences, so we should always beg Krishna's forgiveness.

🎙 Maharaj at 129:28 (auto-transcript): “We constantly examine ourselves and see how we are doing, as my devotion says. So examine that. And when we understand we have met someone pure, but not sweet, we are not happy as we are supposed to be, we should know that something is wrong, even if we don't say some obvious…”

children.topic: Q5 · Life got harder after spirituality
children.note:
A young devotee's life became harder after illness and taking up spiritual practice; she longs for her old, easier self.

🎙 Maharaj at 131:32 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Prabhuji. Hare Krishna. So, life was very good. My life was very good in school and college, but suddenly something happened. My life got worse. Health issue got caught up. so before i was very happy then after the health issue i developed in spirituality but…”

When a devotee still carries some material desire, Krishna arranges purification; what looks like punishment is his mercy, and verse 8 will explain more. Krishna knows exactly what you must pass through to reach him — tolerate it and keep practising. — “it is Krishna's mercy for us”

🎙 Maharaj at 133:49 (auto-transcript): “The punishment we get is, it is Krishna's mercy for us, but we don't understand it, we are taking it in a different way. So it is Christian's purification for you, so it should not be moral. So understand that a Christian is purifying, so let me tolerate it. Actually we are…”

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 02 · How Devotees Conquer Krishna

nodeData.topic: Day 02 · How Devotees Conquer Krishna
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.3-4 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj recalls that Brahma prayed only to please Krishna and asks us to paint our hearts with the form Brahma describes, showing that we already see Krishna daily in many ways. On verse 3 he explains how the unconquerable Lord is conquered by devotees who dedicate body, words and mind to hearing about him, illustrated by the dealings of love; on verse 4 he shows that knowledge without devotion bewilders even the learned. In the questions he explains why Krishna loves hearing his devotees glorified and how to study scripture without becoming dry. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Recalling the first class, Maharaj stresses that Brahma asked for nothing — no promotion, no power over demons — he simply wanted to please Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:02 (auto-transcript): “If you remember last week, we were explaining that Lord Brahma has a purpose in offering his prayers. and he made it very very clear he made his purpose of offering the prayers to Krishna very clear and most common word we were using in the last lecture that Lord Brahma just…”

This is the foundation of pure Krishna consciousness and the meaning of success. If the purpose is not to please Krishna, Maharaj says there is no reason even to eat, sleep or breathe. — “to please Lord Krishna with our life”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:21 (auto-transcript): “and it is the foundation for pure Krishna consciousness at the foundation the devotees should not do anything without the main reason to please Krishna because if he please Lord Krishna in everything that we do. Lord Krishna becomes very pleased and that is what is considered…”

Brahma painted Krishna's form for us. Our meditation, rupa-dhyana, is to paint our hearts with Krishna's sweet form.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:24 (auto-transcript): “And he was describing Krishna, he painted our heart with beautiful Krishna form. For us, Rupdhyan. Rupdhyan. We should meditate on the form, the transcendental supreme form of Krishna. That is the problem for us. For us, Rupdhyan is painting our heart with the supreme, sweet…”

Citing an acarya, Maharaj recalls Krishna praising the breeze as rightly named because it carries Srimati Radharani's fragrance — and asks what we carry in our own hearts.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:23 (auto-transcript): “remembering Prabhu Dhananda Saraswati, where he mentioned Lord Krishna glorifying the breeze, the air, the wind. But the Christian said, you are properly named Gandabaha. You are properly named Gandabaha. You carry in your heart the fragrance of Srimati Radha Dhani. This is…”

The acaryas light the path so we can walk it. Having no path of our own, we are not to follow any other route than the one they establish. — “because they carry the torch,”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:04 (auto-transcript): “Our challenge are here to show the light. They show the light. so we can walk the path. That is a duty, to show the light for us to walk the path. That is the reason why we are told to listen to Acharya, we should follow Acharya, because they carry the torch, they lift the…”

Maharaj puts the question to the class: if someone asks whether you have seen God, what would you answer, and with what explanation?

🎙 Maharaj at 48:28 (auto-transcript): “Someone asks you, have you seen God? What would you say? If someone asks you, have you seen God? I had a question, I had a question every time, I always say all these years. Have you seen God? What would be the answer? Yes, no. Or yes, what explanation? Or no, what…”

children.topic: Through the ear and the deity
children.note:
Devotees answer: we see him through hearing, in the deity, in prasadam, in the holy name. Maharaj agrees — one who says he does not see Krishna is not humble but foolish.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:43 (auto-transcript): “we see him through our ears very good in the temple yeah very good Krishna is standing there every day we are seeing Krishna yes in deity's form very good yes we are seeing Krishna every day every day if one says I'm not seeing Krishna if someone says I'm not seeing Krishna…”

Krishna says he is the light of the sun, the strength of the strong, the taste of water and beauty itself. This is seeing him in a general way; a pure devotee's vision is different, but everything has a beginning. — “We see Krishna every day.”

When we meet someone powerful we think of our own gain instead of seeing Krishna's opulence; in difficulty we complain. We want Krishna to do what we want — but he knows what he is doing.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:10 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's opulence. When you see someone very powerful, instead of us, we see Krishna, ah, this is Krishna, he's written to this person. We say, ah, this one is very powerful, he's become my friend. Selfishness. Because we don't see Krishna. When we have difficulty, we don't…”
Brahma says that those who give up speculation and dedicate body, words and mind to hearing about Krishna conquer the Lord who cannot otherwise be conquered.

Krishna is the unconquerable one who becomes conquered. Maharaj asks the class: what is the method?

🎙 Maharaj at 54:27 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is what? Ajita Jitopi. That is Krishna. One who is unconquerable has become conquered. What is the method? What is the method of conquering Krishna? In proper order, it is mentioned. Here the word Upa, Uda Pasha, Uda Pasha, clearly indicates that one should not even…”

Quoting Rupa Gosvami, Maharaj asks what 'blunt' means — like a knife that cannot cut, or the blunt end of a pen. Our senses cannot reach beyond matter, so speculating about Krishna fails from the start; we should try to understand the acaryas' exact words.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:36 (auto-transcript): “Because Sri Rupa Goswami has quoted a verse, Atah Sri Krishna Namadhi, Navabugriya Indriyahi, Rupa Goswami is quoting this verse, our senses are blunt. You understand the word blunt? anyone know the word blunt what is blunt blunt senses what is the meaning dull thank you dull…”

children.topic: Let me not be born there
children.note:
Maharaj shares a prayer heard that morning: let me not be born where Krishna's name, devotees, topics and form are absent. Where one constantly hears about Krishna, that alone is sufficient.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:14 (auto-transcript): “yes we are hearing this morning from Chetan Bhagwat right this morning we are hearing this morning from Chetan Bhagwat very beautiful prayer let me not let me not be born in a place where the name of Krishna is not broadcasted Where the votaries of Christians are not there.…”

children.topic: Body, words and mind for Krishna
children.note:
Maharaj asks what is required to conquer Krishna: when our body, mind, senses, words and activities are fully given to him, Krishna becomes captured.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:40 (auto-transcript): “Krishna, what is required to conquer Lord Krishna? What is required to conquer Lord Krishna? When one abandon speculative knowledge and the one's body, one's word, one's mind offer all respect to descriptions of your personality and activities. Dedicating their lives to these…”

Jnanis, yogis and karmis cannot capture Krishna; only devotees can, because they know the secret. — “Only devotees can capture Krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:54 (auto-transcript): “Krishna becomes captured. Although Krishna is unconquerable, Jnani cannot capture Krishna. Yogis cannot capture Lord Krishna. Kormis cannot capture Lord Krishna. Only devotees can capture Krishna because they know the secrets. They know the secrets. Yes. In the case of…”

Maharaj repeats it with delight: Krishna's body stays by his devotees, his words glorify them and his mind thinks of them. One who keeps Krishna's form in the heart has him locked up there.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:37 (auto-transcript): “I want to repeat it. The devotees conquer lord krishna lord krishna's body is conquered because he always remained by the side of his pure devotees by the mind devotees devotees like we mentioned before rubyana to fix lord krishna in the mind one who does that is what i…”

Krishna allows himself to be controlled by his devotees. When you love someone, there is no difference between you any more.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:52 (auto-transcript): “Krishna allows himself to be controlled by the devotees. That is natural. When you love somebody, there is no difference between you and the person again. So Popeye told of King of England or that? King of England? It's a queen. The security The guys were well-equipped at the…”

children.topic: A great man becomes a horse
children.note:
Visitors kept waiting at a heavily guarded great man's house peeped in and saw him on all fours, carrying his grandson on his back. In love the grandson becomes the controller.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:06 (auto-transcript): “So Popeye told of King of England or that? King of England? It's a queen. The security The guys were well-equipped at the gate and all around the man's house. And when people came to see him, they were asked to wait. While they were waiting and waiting and waiting, they were…”

When Arjuna told Krishna to drive the chariot between the armies, Krishna did not protest that he was the Supreme Person; he simply drove. That is love.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:42 (auto-transcript): “Like Arjuna and Krishna. When Arjuna told Krishna, please take me to the middle of the water, I want to see who is standing in the fire. Krishna didn't say, oh, no, no, why can you order me like that? Don't you know I'm the supreme person? Krishna didn't say that. As soon as…”

Kamsa tried to control Krishna by force and failed, but the cowherd boys climb onto his shoulders. — “We cannot control Krishna by power.”

🎙 Maharaj at 71:26 (auto-transcript): “We cannot control Krishna by power. There's no person who can control Krishna by power. Kamsa tried, he didn't succeed. Or they didn't want to trade, he didn't succeed. But the kawaii boy, they didn't try to succeed. The kawaii boy, they climb on Krishna's shoulders. They can…”

children.topic: The gopis' scolding, sweeter than hymns
children.note:
Krishna says the gopis' chastisement blocks his ears from the perfectly metred praises of the personified Vedas.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:43 (auto-transcript): “They can chastise love Krishna. In fact, love Krishna said that the chastisement he gets he gets from the gopis block his ear from from hearing the vedas personified chanting his glories they are chanting christian glory a perfect meter with accurate meter with expertise i…”

Maharaj voices a gopi: this boy fled the city to hide in the forest so he could steal and block girls taking their goods to market — he could never do that among civilised people!

🎙 Maharaj at 73:09 (auto-transcript): “Krishna, you were born in a city. Why did you leave the city to come and live in the forest? Immediately, I have the answer. I will tell you. I will tell you the answer. Just listen. I will tell you the answer. This boy, this boy, how can he stay in the city? Many exalted…”

The Vedas could never call Krishna a cheater, but the gopis say it confidently, and Krishna enjoys it. This pure love belongs only to Krishna's devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:00 (auto-transcript): “business personified can never choose this word for Krishna. Never. But the gopis can use it confidently. And Krishna said, I enjoy it. So much so that when the business personified are chanting, I don't hear. This is pure love. This is pure love. It is only what Krishna…”
Brahma contrasts devotional service with the fruitless labour of speculation.

Knowledge without devotion is like a well with no water. If Krishna is beyond our senses, what will we gain by it?

To please Krishna, speak about his devotees: say Radhe and Krishna is pleased, say Krishna and Radharani is pleased — say Radhe Krishna and both are pleased.

nodeData.topic: Day 03 · Faith That Walks on Water
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.5 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On verse 5 Maharaj explains how great yogis and sages abandoned their own paths for bhakti, because bhakti is a kingdom compared to a small flat, and that real advancement shows as a burning eagerness to hear and chant. Fully surrendered devotees have no fear, since fear is faithlessness; he illustrates living faith with Sankaracarya's disciple Padmapada and King Kulasekhara. In the questions he shows how faith grows through attentive hearing, through stories of Lord Rama's name and a disciple of Narottama dasa Thakura, and advises keeping confidential realisations to oneself. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma recalls that many yogis of the past reached pure devotion through hearing and chanting, and so came to Krishna's abode.

Citing Sanatana Gosvami, Maharaj tells of powerful sages, perfect in austerity and knowledge, who met Krishna face to face at Kurukshetra. The holy place and the Lord's presence changed their consciousness and they gave up their own pursuits.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:51 (auto-transcript): “Sir Sanatana Goswami in the Rehad Bhagavatam Gita said that when Krishna was physically present, when he was physically, powerful personality, Maharishi is like that. Maharishi, like Basishtamuni, Basishtamuni said Maharishi, Basishtamuni, Gautamuni, and Bishamitramuni.”

They begged Krishna for bhakti. When he said they were already perfect and needed nothing, they answered that if they were satisfied they would not have come — when one becomes fortunate, bhakti becomes attractive. Krishna was very pleased.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:18 (auto-transcript): “The two of them, they went to Krishna and they begged of Krishna. Please, give us bhakti. Krishna said, you asking for bhakti? You're really satisfied. You're perfect. There's no need for you for bhakti. You're really going with them looking for you. No, don't tell us that.…”

No one leaves a palace to live in a small two-bedroom flat, but anyone would leave a flat for a palace. All other processes are small flats; bhakti is a kingdom with countless buildings. — “So bhakti like a kingdom”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:26 (auto-transcript): “but we have never had we have never had in history that doctors have approached a Christian for we have never had that and I'm sure we'll never we'll never hear it because it doesn't it doesn't work like that nobody would like to leave the palace to come and say in a 2BSK but…”

children.topic: The sign of advancement: eager hearing
children.note:
We know we are advancing when our interest in hearing and chanting Krishna's glories keeps increasing — when it is burning.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:46 (auto-transcript): “This is the important thing. When we know we are making advancement, when our interest to hear and chant about the glorious of Christians is increasing, it is burning. Our desire to hear about christian not not like a genie or speculatus who want to hear so go and speak to…”

A bird in the Himalayas hears once and can repeat everything exactly, but practises nothing. Hearing only to repeat it to others, like a speculator, is useless.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:12 (auto-transcript): “the what is does not hear just because he wants to hear to go and speak to others like a burunda bird in the himalayas in the himalayas lived a burunda bird burunda bird so perfect hearer, perfect listener, perfect shrutidar. You hear once and everything recorded in your head…”

Bona fide hearing plants Krishna in the heart. When we hear because we like the person, we hear better, and the joy makes us want to hear again and again.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:13 (auto-transcript): “devotional service. We hear because we like the person. When we hear because you like the person, you will hear better. Because it gives one joy to hear. One wants to hear again and again. That is devotion. All infallible ones. And could easily surrender to you and achieve…”

Without hearing you cannot know or appreciate anything. In the beginning we hear to understand; as we mature we hear for the pleasure of it — bhakti brings more bhakti. — “And you cannot love the person without hearing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:44 (auto-transcript): “If one doesn't hear, what will you want to chant? If you don't hear, what will you know? You can never know anything without hearing about it. You cannot appreciate anything without hearing. And you can also hear if you don't love the person. And you cannot love the person…”

Rejected karma, jnana and yoga become chaff. Simply by hearing the acaryas we can see where we are in Krishna consciousness; our scriptures are not novels for passing time but show our position, Krishna's position and our duty. — “Our scripture, they are not just novel.”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:07 (auto-transcript): “That is the result of bhakti. when we reject karma, when we reject kyan, when we reject yoga. Because they become like what? Chaps. Useless. So it is not difficult for one to understand where we are in Christian consciousness. It's not difficult. Simply listen to the…”

Maharaj asks the class whether it is true that followers of Krishna have no fear or anxiety. A devotee, by definition, is surrendered; saying 'I cannot follow' only shows we are not.

A dog never tells its master it will not go out today, and a car does not refuse to be driven. They depend on the master's will; a devotee has no desire separate from his master's.

A pure devotee's anxiety is spiritual: how to spread Krishna consciousness and how to push those who say they have given their lives to Krishna to drop their garbage and become real devotees. Preaching comes first, prasadam second.

children.note:
We say we have faith — but what kind? Maharaj asks the class to consider the quality of their faith in guru and Krishna, and wishes they become such devotees. — “what is the quality of the faith we have”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:35 (auto-transcript): “Yes, it is true you have the faith, but what kind of faith do you have? what is the quality of the faith we have what is the quality what is the quality of faith we have in our good the quality of faith we have in Christian what is it what is it thank you thank you I wish you…”

As in the Gita, Krishna says many were purified by this process before. Before joining a school or company you check what became of its graduates; likewise check how many became pure devotees by a process before you join.

nodeData.topic: Day 04 · Only by a Pure Devotee's Mercy
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj stresses that Brahma shares realisation, not philosophy: his intelligence reeled when he saw the 'uncultured' cowherd boy doing the impossible, and even devotees like those around young Nimai could not fathom the Lord. Even the impersonal aspect needs heavy austerity, while the personal Krishna is reached only by the mercy of pure devotees — the reason we owe everything to Srila Prabhupada. In the questions he speaks on approaching Krishna submissively through pleasing service, self-doubt, the danger of familiarity, cameras switched off in class and how to overcome lust. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma says non-devotees cannot know Krishna personally, and even his impersonal aspect is realised only after purifying mind and senses.

Brahma speaks from his own experience — his offence and what Krishna did to him — and we should know the difference between that and philosophy. — “He is sharing his deliberate realizations.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:09 (auto-transcript): “We should always remember that Brahma is not giving us philosophy. He is sharing his deliberate realizations. You know, speaking to most of it, you should know the difference. It's a realization he is sharing. He is a knowledgeable person. He is a knowledgeable person. So…”

Brahma saw a boy he took to be uncultured, eating with his left hand among illiterate friends, do something unimaginable.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:32 (auto-transcript): “the product. The Brahma word means what? It's intelligence pain. It's intelligence pain. You know when somebody knock you from the back of the head, how do you feel? Somebody give you a knock at the back of your head, how do you feel? The brain will reel. The brain will reel.…”

children.topic: A knock on the back of the head
children.note:
Maharaj asks how you feel when someone knocks the back of your head: the brain reels and you understand nothing for a while. A tiny speck of Krishna's mystic power did that to Brahma.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:53 (auto-transcript): “somebody knock you from the back of the head, how do you feel? Somebody give you a knock at the back of your head, how do you feel? The brain will reel. The brain will reel. You cannot understand anything for some time. That's what happened to the Brahmin. He was a knocked…”

As if cleaning his glasses, Brahma looks again: the boy has been eating with his friends for a year, coming home daily with cows and boys, and at the same time appearing as Vishnu forms. And it is really him doing it. — “What am I seeing?”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:50 (auto-transcript): “When he removed his glass to clean his eyes, see properly, put back the glass and look at the small boy standing before him for one year. Christian was holding his foot for one year. What was it? Christian was holding his foot with left hand for one year. Christian was coming…”

children.topic: Even devotees could not fathom him
children.note:
Brahma speaks of non-devotees — but what about devotees? Maharaj turns to Mahaprabhu's student days in Navadvipa.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:23 (auto-transcript): “Even devotees. What about devotees? He's talking about non-devotees. What about devotees? When Jita Muhammad was in Navadu, he was harassing his devotees. Not only the non-devotees he was harassing. See, this time I was harassing a devotee, especially every day. Hey, Mukunda,…”

Nimai Pandita would catch Mukunda, who avoided him, and test his Sanskrit: 'not up to standard — in Kali-yuga people can't pronounce a word yet hold degrees.'

🎙 Maharaj at 39:31 (auto-transcript): “When Jita Muhammad was in Navadu, he was harassing his devotees. Not only the non-devotees he was harassing. See, this time I was harassing a devotee, especially every day. Hey, Mukunda, sit here today. You have been avoiding me. I will see how you avoid me today. Today, tell…”

The devotees sat apart, wondering: no human being could be like this — if only this boy were a devotee. The Lord covered them so his pastimes could unfold fully.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “One day, devotees, they all came together, and they sat down. What is this? He's speaking, he's not speaking. But the devotees came and sat, not in the group. They sat separately. We're looking. I said, boy, is he not? Because no human being can have structure. No human being…”

Krishna demonstrated personally that he is supreme in everything — in philosophy, in cheating, even proudly in the art of stealing. Intelligent people are proud of their intellect; Krishna challenges all of them.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:04 (auto-transcript): “his personal master squad as a supreme position of God who can defeat him in anything, anything he is supreme, he is supreme in everything he demonstrated that personally, physically, he demonstrated did as a supreme is supreme in everything if you're cheating supreme if a…”

A devotee told Maharaj he thought education would cover his deficiencies; he got it, and nothing changed. — “for Krishna, everything changed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:03 (auto-transcript): “one devotee told me this morning i was i was thinking that i would think that i would get the devotee is here, I won't call them, the devotee is here. So he told me that I would think it I would be educated so that I can cover all other deficiencies. I got it, but still,…”

The heavyweight champion is beaten and never returns; today's richest man is overtaken tomorrow. The owner takes his gift back, and most people do not know who the owner is — here Brahma clearly presents him.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:44 (auto-transcript): “I've seen somebody who stand up two times you know I get two times, it's once the second time, they are finished the heaviest boxing champion in the whole world how many times you do that it's finished, the owner will withdraw it it will be helpless so many boxers will be…”

Even to grasp Krishna's impersonal feature, our blunt senses must be purified by heavy austerity, including study of scripture. It does not happen by sitting in a room waiting.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:57 (auto-transcript): “we need to perform austerity to come to the level of to purify our blood senses remember we used that word that day, blood senses to purify our blood senses to be able to even in the material form of Krishna we need heavy austerity to build, heavy austerity austerity of…”

Millions stop at Brahman, thinking they have arrived. But light cannot exist without its source: trace the bulb's cable to the powerhouse. Brahman is the light, Paramatma the cable, Bhagavan the powerhouse. — “So nothing can exist without the powerhouse.”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:01 (auto-transcript): “But if the light will exist without the source, light will exist without the source. we see a little bomb, the light is shining in. Behind the light, there's an object there. And if you trace it, there's a cable behind it, right? If you trace the cable, it will go to the…”

children.topic: Only by a pure devotee's mercy
children.note:
Recalling the sages transformed at the holy place, Maharaj stresses that the personal Krishna is reached only by the mercy of a pure devotee — and pure devotees make themselves available to us.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:24 (auto-transcript): “We mentioned the other day, They transcended their position by associating directly to the potency of the holy plan, et cetera, et cetera, the medication, et cetera. It became transformed. Here they demonstrated the importance of the holy place. and by the mercy of the whole…”

Maharaj recalls a boy setting out who knew nothing, yet the sage came to meet him on the way; the meeting was the sage's mercy, not the boy's search.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:53 (auto-transcript): “When the Draugam Maharaj was... coming to the local commission. He didn't know anything about Narayanan. He didn't know anything about Narayanan. When Narayanan came and met him, I said, oh boy, why are you going? Why are you going? Narayanan came to meet him. The same thing…”

Who among us asked Prabhupada to go? Seekers went to India and found nothing; they came home and Prabhupada was waiting for them, sent by Krishna to bring them back. — “Out of his mercy, he went there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:17 (auto-transcript): “When Prabhupada was going to America, how many of us said, so Prabhupada going to America? How many of us saw him? How many, so Prabhupada going to America for us? Who saw? We didn't see him. Out of his mercy, he went there. Out of his mercy, he went to death. And then, when…”

Be intelligent and appreciative: wherever anyone goes today, it is Prabhupada who made them know that person, and even that person came through Prabhupada's disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:45 (auto-transcript): “that. So, we should be intelligent, we should be appreciative, not to say anything wrong. Anywhere anybody goes today, it is Prabhupada who sent, who made us to know that person, that person. It is Prabhupada, not you. Not even that person you are going to meet. And after…”

Maharaj voices his own attitude: don't share your plate with me, I will finish what Prabhupada gave me, however long it takes. You may go elsewhere — but are we really eating what we were given?

🎙 Maharaj at 56:15 (auto-transcript): “please don't share with me eat your things I will eat my one here don't worry keep your I will eat the one the progba has given to me that is sufficient for me yes that is enough for me don't share with me I will get one the one progba gave me I will not finish eating I will…”

Echoing a Nigerian musician, Maharaj says suffering and enjoyment alike are our own doing. Krishna consciousness is a great science to be learned, or we remain locked out.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:19 (auto-transcript): “When the powerful Nigerian musician he said suffering suffering suffering it is what it's your fault that is our fault just like enjoyment it's our fault so suffering is our fault everything is our fault so we should understand this the mercy of a pure devotee and or the…”

After a directed free-writing exercise led by the hosts on using the association of pure devotees, a question held over from the day before and four new ones.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:18 (auto-transcript): “move on to the question and answer section and we have one question from yesterday's session before we would move on to the questions from today's session so the question was from Sumit Prabhu Krushant Prabhu we're just taking a while to find it out and until then if devotees…”

children.topic: Q1 · What to ask Krishna for?
children.note:
If, as the Madhurya-kadambini says, bhakti is independent and not obtained even by the Lord's mercy, what should one ask Krishna for to grow in it?

🎙 Maharaj at 74:51 (auto-transcript): “Sushant Prabhuri's question yesterday was Hare Krishna Maharaj, kindly accept my humble obeisances I heard in some lecture once that in Madhuriya Kadambini Vishnath Chakravarti Thakur has explained us that Bhakti is completely independent you cannot get that even by Lord's…”

We must approach Krishna's devotees, and the attitude must be submissive: no challenging, reverence, an open heart and open ears.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:41 (auto-transcript): “approach approach. Our attitude to approach should be submissive. Submissive means there's no trying. There's no challenging solution. Reverence is there. Open heart. Open the ears. So we may make approach, maybe submissive in our attitude. But if you don't have service,…”

children.topic: Service to please, not to impose
children.note:
Approach must be completed by service, offered as Brahma offered his prayers — to please. We often want others to accept what we like instead of what pleases them.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:27 (auto-transcript): “complete service that service also qualified the service might be the beginning where i mentioned a lot brahma is offering prayers to christmas you know offering prayers to get something so that is the move the service will be running the service just to please the people you…”

Am I serving for my own prestige? Forcing a guest to eat what and how much I eat is not devotional service; if he only drinks water and is happy, that is service.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:49 (auto-transcript): “the motivation is required what is the motivation for doing the service am I doing it for my own prestige you know when the shadows come to this city it is my house Only in my body. Yes. Yes, God, you don't know this. You know? Any sudden you come to this town, it's my house.…”

Small failures deeply disturb a devotee, who then criticises herself inside. How to become steady and trust Krishna's mercy?

🎙 Maharaj at 82:20 (auto-transcript): “Mataji is asking, Hare Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble obeisances. I wanted to seek your guidance. I often struggle with self-doubt and self-glame. Even small things disturb my mind deeply And if I fail to follow something properly in devotional service Or even in…”

Chant more and hear more every day, with real endeavour. As the heart is purified, the emotional mind becomes strong.

🎙 Maharaj at 83:02 (auto-transcript): “Please chant more we should chant more not just a singer we should chant more we should hear more let us hear more every day we should chant more every day we should we should make a endeavor unless a endeavor was received then our heart becomes purified and developed”

We tend to become familiar with devotees and with the process. What is the defence?

🎙 Maharaj at 84:41 (auto-transcript): “is from Sachin Prabhupada and Rupali Mataji they are asking how to overcome familiarity in the process of practicing devotion we have the tendency to become familiar with devotees and process many times what is the defense for this tendency becoming familiar means we are…”

Familiarity means losing the sense of difference: I start to feel superior and minimise what the other says. We are all spiritual, but not equal in advancement.

🎙 Maharaj at 85:15 (auto-transcript): “we are going beyond our intuition now we don't know the difference so i start to put myself superior then this one that would minimize you whatever you tell me not so much importance if there is a boundary, I will always understand that, yes, we are spiritual, but we are not…”

Lord Kapila instructed his mother. Had Devahuti said 'keep quiet, I carried you in my womb', she would have received nothing — as many family members treat a young devotee today.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:23 (auto-transcript): “In Chetan Bhagwati, we hear that, look, and he's quoted that when Ted Kanto Kapi Muni is speaking to his mother, philosophy, that is not the usual case. The usual case is that the mother is superior, so he's training the child. But in this case, the child is the supreme God,…”

If your son becomes prime minister, you cannot shout at him in his office — there is protocol. The sages of Naimisaranya, with their many disciples, did not minimise Suta Gosvami as a mere boy.

🎙 Maharaj at 87:33 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, you see, materially speaking, if your son becomes a prime minister, will you go and shout at him in his office? It's your son. In his office, you will shout at him in the office. He'll be arrested. No, no, no, it's my son. You don't know, it's my son. It's my son, but…”

The conquering scholar Kesava Kasmiri dismissed Nimai as a small grammar teacher. After his instant verses, Nimai respectfully pointed out redundancy and inconsistency, and the scholar sweated — from anxiety, not ecstasy. Minimising a superior person costs everything.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:48 (auto-transcript): “When the Dick Vijay, when Dick Vijay, Keseva Katsuniri, oh, that boy of grammar, that's what he said. Oh, that small boy of grammar. It's a validity. He didn't understand the supremacy because he was, ah, that small boy of grammar? oh yeah yeah yeah okay that's it that's a…”

A disciple worries that, though Maharaj asks for cameras on, most devotees attend class with their cameras off.

🎙 Maharaj at 100:12 (auto-transcript): “Krishna Seelagrudev, please accept my humble obeys senses. Because you always try to engage us in every aspect, how to progress and listen to become serious, sincere. But our enjoying propensity in material life is so strong. Even we are trying our best, we feel genuinely…”

A poor network explains perhaps one per cent; the rest is duplicity — joining so people know I am there while doing something else. Nobody forces you; at least be honest. Can you run away from yourself? — “The person is not there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 101:30 (auto-transcript): “Do you know why the camera is switched off? You know? Why the camera is switched off? I don't know why. The person is not there. The person is not there. The camera is switched off because the person is not there. Insincerity. Duplicity. I put on the camera and then I put…”

Maharaj first asks the class to define lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 105:00 (auto-transcript): “Okay, last one was I had to overcome lust for me. Sweat. I had to overcome lust. Do you know what is lust? Do you know what is lust? L-U-S-T. Let not L-O-S-T. L-U-S-T. Do you know what is lust? Anyone can tell me what is lust? You tell me. It's quite hard to overcome it. What…”

Lust is not merely material desire; its real meaning is the opposite of pure love for God. The soul is a natural lover of God, and when that love is transformed it becomes selfishness.

🎙 Maharaj at 105:48 (auto-transcript): “Opposite of. not opposite of love it's opposite of pure love opposite of pure love of godness opposite pure love of godness not love that is lost that is material that is secondary the primary meaning the loss is opposite of pure love of godness there is philosophical reason…”

The first principle: stay fully occupied all day — not only chanting, but planning and executing services — and practise helping others even at inconvenience. What good have I done today?

🎙 Maharaj at 107:41 (auto-transcript): “So how to overcome it? Many techniques are there. First principle. one should not be idle the whole day should not be idle fully I don't say chanting don't jump ahead just listen I didn't say all the chanting I said should not be idle that's what I said can you chant in 24…”

Treat everyone nicely and wish them well; negative minds breed unhappiness and even sickness. When Krishna sees someone sharing his load, he starts taking care of that person. — “if we don't love people, nobody will love us”

🎙 Maharaj at 112:40 (auto-transcript): “So you should think good about it. start to do good when Krishna sees that this person is sharing my my load, my anxiety Krishna will start taking care that is why even common people they hear Nigeria and South Africa who give us their lack because they are always thinking…”

nodeData.topic: Day 05 · He Came for Our Benefit
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.7 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On verse 7 Maharaj dwells on Krishna descending for our benefit: he brought the Yamuna, Vrindavan, Govardhana and his associates with him, so that even the trees, vegetables and roses of the holy dhamas carry his touch. Krishna's qualities are beyond counting and come alive only in him, while we misuse what he gives — Maharaj illustrates this with deities he once gave that became a cause of quarrel. He closes with a meditation, through Prabodhananda Sarasvati's eyes, on Krishna lovingly dressing Srimati Radharani, showing that real worship is absorption. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma says that even if scholars could count every atom and star, no one could count the qualities of the Lord who descended for all beings.

children.topic: What do we gain from his coming?
children.note:
Maharaj asks the class what benefit Krishna's appearance brings us. The benefits are innumerable. — “It is for our benefit.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:42 (auto-transcript): “Krishna appeared in this world for the benefit of all divinity. That is the purpose of Krishna coming to this world. It is for our benefit. What is the benefit Krishna's appearance is doing for us? What is the benefit? What are we benefiting from Krishna's appearance in this…”

children.topic: Krishna brought his world with him
children.note:
Because Krishna was coming, the Yamuna came. Ordinary water cleans only if you bathe, just as food satisfies only if you eat — but simply looking at the Yamuna purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:16 (auto-transcript): “It is because Krishna is coming here that Jamuna came. Because Krishna was coming here. Jamuna came. And what is Jamuna? Baiting in Jamuna won't get purified. And even looking at Jamuna without biting won't get purified. What a speciousness for all the mutatives. What a…”

Gokula and Vrindavan came because Krishna was coming; he made the arrangements and brought his spiritual world down. Prabhupada said one feels different on entering Vrindavan.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:27 (auto-transcript): “It is because Christian was coming here that Gokul Bhandavan came. Gokul Bhandavan came because Christian was coming here. because Kisan was coming. He has to make the arrangement before coming. Kisan brought his spiritual world down here. So the Papa said that once one…”

On his first visit Maharaj knew nothing of Vrindavan's significance, yet the moment he left he felt something was wrong and cried on the train. That is how one knows one has felt the difference.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:07 (auto-transcript): “I have a testimony to that. Testimony. The first time I went to Brindavan, I didn't know what the right thing. What is Brindavan material i don't know first time i went there as a foolish outsider we spent few days because my sister myself was there and we spent all the few…”

Govardhana, the best of Hari's servants, provides everything for Vraja's residents. Pure devotees like Raghunatha dasa Gosvami prayed to live by him, near Radha-kunda and Manasi-ganga, where wish-fulfilling trees appeared.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:43 (auto-transcript): “And because Christian came with God of God, God of God, God of God, Haridas, Baria, God of God, provide every single need for the busy passes. Every single need. So we see, pure devotee, like Ramonadas Goswami, they pray to have the mercy of God of God to stay by God of God,…”

Jiva Gosvami told Syamananda Pandita he had a question: despite careful watering and heavy monsoon rain, all the trees he tended had died except one. Was it because of his sins?

🎙 Maharaj at 43:00 (auto-transcript): “One day, Serajeeva Goswami was icing Siamanandpondi. Siamanandpondi, I have a question for you. So Siamanandpondi, yes, please, you're my master. Can you imagine when a teacher says, I want to ask you a question? How do you feel? The teacher, he was, I have a question for…”

Syamananda asked for time and went to his cottage to contemplate — Maharaj recalls yesterday's stress on contemplation — and entered into the pastime to find the answer.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:30 (auto-transcript): “So someone who said, my dear Lord, just give me a short time, give me a short time, let me go and meditate. You see, yesterday we were talking about what? Contemplation. Very important. Very important. He said, let me go and investigate. He's communicating with the Supersoul.…”

The trees were Krishna's associates who had come with him and left with their beloved; the surviving tree was planted by Jiva Gosvami and would leave when he did. — “they couldn't stay here without their beloved”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:44 (auto-transcript): “Then he came back in the evening to see Jivami Swami. And he said, my dear Sleva Koshwami, you see all these plants here you said they left they came with krishna they came with krishna and they couldn't stay here without their beloved so they left but this one this one you…”

Krishna established all his associates here — Govardhana, Yamuna, Ganga, Tulasi. Those who live by them are fortunate: vegetables from Mayapur, nourished by the Ganga, taste different, and Vrindavan's roses are unlike any others.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:24 (auto-transcript): “So you see so many fortunate people, they bet the whole of their lifetime, they are betting, they are watching, they are drinking Jemona, Ganga. Can you imagine their fortune? Can you imagine their fortune? Everything they do is Ganga. If you, if you, next time when you go,…”

Radha-kunda is the best, yet its water is salty from the slaying of Aristasura; roses grown by the Yamuna are cool, fresh and fragrant, already prasadam.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:55 (auto-transcript): “Radha Koon water is salty. Jemwanda water is not salty. You know, it is salty because of the healing of demons. Krishna killed so many demons. Radha Koon is what? Arista Sura. Salty. Arista Sura. Even though Radha Koon is the best. It's the best. But some influence of Arista…”

children.topic: Spiritual envy: a contest of love
children.note:
Krishna need not come here to dance with the gopis; he does so eternally in Goloka, where no one questions it because everyone participates.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:13 (auto-transcript): “then christian himself what about his past times what about christian's past times christian does not need to come here and dance with the groupies he is doing that in global he doesn't need to come and dance here because if he doesn't see everybody oh why ah how can god do…”

When everyone eats the same meal no one feels different; questions arise when you have shukta and I don't. Material envy says: don't come near or you're finished — a dangerous, demonic envy.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:01 (auto-transcript): “different right when the shukta is in your plate i don't see my plate wow that is the question the question why is coming from the fact that we are not participating shukta in a plate and what do you do that you have shukta and i don't have yes you are very push that's why…”

In the spiritual world envy is a competition of love, an eternal 'fight' that never ends because everything there only increases. — “i want to love you more than you love me”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:16 (auto-transcript): “a demonic envy very dangerous the spiritual envy is a spiritual competition is a competition of love yes i want to love you more than you love me that's the easy in the spiritual in me spiritual envy i i want to love you both and your love for me then they say fight yes that…”

Even granting that scientists could count every atom and star, Krishna's pastimes and qualities are unlimited. We are infinitesimal, and our own size is given in scripture as a minute fraction of a hair's tip.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:20 (auto-transcript): “so that that is the a primer here now if you want to go into philosophy then you can look at what brahma is saying in time linear philosophers or scientists may be able to count all the atoms of the earth even if they are able to count all the atoms they can count the…”

children.topic: Cut a hair into a hundred
children.note:
Can any scientist cut one hair into a hundred parts, and one of those into a hundred again? If not, how will they count Krishna's endless pastimes?

🎙 Maharaj at 55:24 (auto-transcript): “even cut it like that can even can anyone our scientists measure that cut it like that take one hair not your long hair is it not your long hair just a piece of the hair and cut it into 100 can the scientists do that yeah a piece of hair you can cut it into 100 and that one…”

Good qualities are meaningful because Krishna exhibits them. We wear ornaments to cover our ugliness; Krishna wears them to make the ornaments valuable.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:12 (auto-transcript): “In other words, these qualities are meaningful because Krishna exhibits all of them. They are not decorations for Krishna. They are meaningful because Krishna uses them. That's the difference. We are very ugly. To cover our ugliness, we use ornaments. So Krishna uses…”

Gold kept at home impresses no one; it is noticed only when worn in the street. If that is so for us, how much more for the source of all qualities, who gave them to us out of kindness.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:02 (auto-transcript): “even materially speaking if you are keeping your gold locked up in your room there who knows when you when you walk in the street who knows oh this is this is gold who knows nobody knows the gold becomes appreciative only when you put them and move in the street look at Mrs.…”

Krishna gives us these things to use in his service, but we become proud of them and they become a source of destruction for our love.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:46 (auto-transcript): “for us to use it in this sex but we take these things and become proud of it because doesn't mind what is this what is this a child buys biscuit and give to the child the child is eating the biscuit the policy can look yeah it's for me it's for me But who gave you? Who gave…”

A father buys a child a biscuit and the child will not give any back — will the father give again? Then we call God wicked for not providing. Those who misuse his gifts have them withdrawn.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:08 (auto-transcript): “the child is eating the biscuit the policy can look yeah it's for me it's for me But who gave you? Who gave it to you? The Father gave you. But now you are refusing to give it back to the Father. So the Father will give you again? No. And when the Father did not give, oh, the…”

Maharaj once gave deities to two sisters whose service he appreciated, hoping to make them happy. They began fighting over them; he took the deities back and was criticised for it. — “My intention was not to cause a fight.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:47 (auto-transcript): “To make it practical, make it practical, I gave two sisters, Father Krishna did. They are sisters, one father and one mother, the same. So I gave them a deity. and then my intention was I just like them, I appreciate their service so you take these deities and worship my…”

Maharaj recalls Prabhupada wishing to remove the marble from his buildings because disciples were fighting over the temples — not a contest of love but a dividing of the spiritual master's property, which is very dangerous.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:17 (auto-transcript): “says that I wish to remove all the marbles in my building in other words I want to close on all the temples I constructed because the disciples are fighting over the temple I wish to remove all the marbles in my building they are not fighting for love of God we mentioned that…”

A philosopher observed that money, women, position and power change people. Maharaj adds the example of a man who kept lending money until no one repaid him and he stopped giving.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:19 (auto-transcript): “One philosopher, from his experience, he said that people got changed in this world with so many things. Many things changed people. Many things changed people from what they were before. For example, money will change people. Money. Money will definitely change people. When…”

children.topic: The gopis open the confidential pastimes
children.note:
Maharaj asks the class why Krishna came — to benefit us. Even his own friends cannot enter Radha and Krishna's confidential pastimes; only the gopis can, and they make them available for us.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:46 (auto-transcript): “Krishna came here to do what? Krishna came here to do what? What do you say in the verse? Krishna came here to do what? To benefit us. Thank you. Krishna's purpose of coming here is to benefit us. And for him to do this, to create this benediction moon, he performed…”

Prabodhananda Sarasvati, placing himself as a practitioner like us, wonders whether one like him could ever witness these pastimes. Maharaj asks the class the same question.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:07 (auto-transcript): “these past times when the people that another sexuality had this when he had this when he read this verse will i be so fortunate to witness those sweet persons from madhusudan that cannot even be perceived by the kings of the yogis is it possible for me when such exotic…”

Devotees answer: our fortune is the acaryas and the spiritual master. If it were not possible, why would Krishna have come here to show us and say 'join me'? — “it's possible for us”

🎙 Maharaj at 78:20 (auto-transcript): “when they see the prophet and others were thinking like this he was thinking like this is it possible that a condemned soul like me will have access to this even christian's friends in they don't go look they don't have i say so what about me yes it is possible for us it's…”

By Mahaprabhu's grace Prabodhananda Sarasvati is shown a pastime: as a kinkari he assists while Krishna, the crown jewel of rasikas, attends to Srimati Radharani after their meeting and dresses her before her friends arrive.

Krishna becomes fully absorbed in dressing her. Maharaj tells pujaris to remember this: hanging a dress on the deity mechanically is not worship; a pujari is a kinkari, whether male or female. — “deity worship means for absorption”

As Krishna paints her face his eyes fill and he cannot see. Maharaj compares Mahaprabhu, who could not worship deities because his tears soaked them and their dresses.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:29 (auto-transcript): “the eyes couldn't see properly again chitama doesn't worship deities chitama he doesn't worship deity he did in in a sri rangam sri rangam he worshiped jaganand balayashi for that day but after that he doesn't worship deities because when he sit down to worship deities the…”

When Krishna sweats, the kinkari fans him so that Radharani's fragrance reaches him, and Krishna praises the breeze as rightly named the carrier of fragrance. Maharaj asks again: what do we carry in our minds?

🎙 Maharaj at 96:26 (auto-transcript): “after finding Krishna you see this is Krishna here so he's finding is finding krishna right until the sweat disappeared after the sweat disappeared then being so experienced a devotee he started finding like this like this you understand radharani is here so he's finding from…”

Maharaj has everyone repeat one of Radharani's names, Gandhonmadita-madhava. Then the vision stops and Prabodhananda Sarasvati laments, bowing to the direction from which her fragrance comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:37 (auto-transcript): “One of Swamini's names One of her names Is Gandon Madita Madhava Gandon Madita Madhava What is her name? All of us repeat it What is her name? Gandon Madita Madhava Repeat it Gandun Madhita Madhava. Gandun Madhita Madhava. This is one of Simati Radha Reni's name.”

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 06 · Waiting Gratefully for Mercy

nodeData.topic: Day 06 · Waiting Gratefully for Mercy
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.8 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes a single verse as a complete method: we wait for Krishna's mercy not because he is busy but because our own karma is being cleared, and we wait with gratitude rather than complaint. Krishna is the expert doctor who doses the cure we can bear; troubles that rise when we start chanting are the dirt coming out of the room. In the questions he speaks on feeling separation, rasa, asking the guru, full surrender, and why real tolerance comes from purity. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma describes the devotee who keeps waiting on Krishna's mercy, bears his own past reactions and keeps bowing down — and says liberation is then his by right. Maharaj fixes on that word: eligibility.

Maharaj asks the room what makes liberation our right. Brahma's answer: wait earnestly, consciously and seriously for Krishna to give his causeless mercy. — “What is the qualification to having liberation as our right?”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:44 (auto-transcript): “What is the qualification to having liberation as our right? What is the qualification? What is the qualification? So Brahma mentioned here, the qualifications are that we should very, very earnest, consciously, seriously, cautiously wait for Christ to restore his costless…”

Patience matters because no one can order the Lord. A poor man cannot walk up to a rich person and demand a billion now; how much less can we demand from the Supreme Person.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:26 (auto-transcript): “To wait, patience is very important. Why? We cannot command Christ to give us something. Even in a mundane way, a poor man cannot go to Christmas. and say, Mother, give you one billion now. Now. You have it now. Just give it to me. You cannot do that. You cannot do it. So if…”

Only lawful, obedient citizens have rights. Having turned away from Krishna, we have none of our own — so we must wait, and wait endlessly. — “Deviant has no right.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:11 (auto-transcript): “We are deviants. That is our disqualification. We are deviants. Deviant has no right. only the lawful obedient citizens have rights so we are divines and lawful citizens so we have no right therefore for us to get a message we must wait endlessly for the Lord to restore…”

children.topic: Why the wait: our own karma
children.note:
While we wait we are paying off the debt that makes us unfit for mercy. Waiting is not something Krishna imposes; it is the time our sinful reactions take to be cancelled.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:46 (auto-transcript): “while we are waiting while we are waiting while waiting we are paying off the debt which we owe that is making us unsuitable for the mercy so in other words waiting means what? waiting is not Christ's asking us to wait we are waiting because of our sinful guilt. The karma we…”

Real waiting is not idle. Like someone sitting for hours at a door unsure whether he will be received at all, we wait with some unease — and keep ourselves available for the mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:52 (auto-transcript): “while we are waiting we are not just waiting waiting also requires anxiety anxiety, being uncomfortable while we're waiting, which we're not sure if we're going to get into our house. We're not sure. Will he give me or will not give me? I'm waiting here for two hours. Will he…”

It is not that Krishna has millions ahead of us in a queue, like a holy place where one waits years for a turn to serve. The delay is the reaction of our own activity, not his schedule.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:37 (auto-transcript): “Not that Christian is so busy, but okay, he's so busy. We are attending to 10 million people. Therefore, we have So you have to wait for our time to come. Like one day in Gujarat, to do service there, you have to wait for years before you have the time to do your service. For…”

The attitude while paying our debt is respectful obeisance — appreciating Krishna for considering someone as fallen as we are.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:54 (auto-transcript): “But what is the attitude which we have while we are paying our debt. What is the attitude of Christian? Why is it taking us too long to give the message? That is not the answer. Because as we have mentioned, it is not Christian who is keeping us waiting. It is the reaction of…”

Maharaj says we are, in truth, untouchable, yet Krishna is taking us into account. Out of that appreciation, heart, words and body should all bow together.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:40 (auto-transcript): “so sinful, I'm so degraded, I'm so abominable in everything, in all directions, everything around me is abomination. Actually, I am untouchable. I am untouchable. Yes. Krishna is considering me. So, we should offer our respectful obeisances to him out of appreciation. Even…”

We commit offences — even against the spiritual master and Krishna himself — think nothing of it, and when the result arrives we blame Krishna. Brahma teaches the opposite mood: thankfulness. — “That we are grateful for what Krishna is doing in our life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:28 (auto-transcript): “Today we're trying to mention whether we are doing all kinds of sinful activities, breaking or insulting a special master, blaspheming a special master, crucifying him and do all kinds of things to other workies including Krishna himself. We don't think that we're doing…”

Maharaj says anyone who understands and applies just this one verse, carefully and objectively, will make his life successful in Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:29 (auto-transcript): “So, if we look at this verse carefully, this verse alone is sufficient to give us opportunity to be fully concerned also this verse alone anyone who understands this verse alone scientifically objectively anyone who applies the teaching of this verse this verse alone our life…”

Recalling the previous day's verse, he calls this process one of the gifts of Krishna's descent — a technology that works if applied.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:12 (auto-transcript): “Don't forget, Lord Brahma told us yesterday that Okesa appeared here for our benefit. This is one of the beneficial effects of Krishna's presence, of Krishna's advent in Israel. He came to benedict us. He came to bless us. By giving this process, this is the technology that…”

Without Krishna consciousness we offend easily. Devotees rarely do, and when they slip it is circumstantial, not deliberate, so Krishna and his servants overlook it.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:56 (auto-transcript): “Because when one is not Christian, they're going to make a lot of offenses. If you're not Christian, we will easily make offenses. People who are Christian, they hardly make offense. Even if they make offense, Krishna and their servants will not see it. They will ignore it.…”

From the commentary: a legitimate son only has to stay alive to inherit his father's property. The devotee only has to stay alive in Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “Srila Swamy explains in his commentary that just as a legitimate son has to simply remain alive to gain an inheritance from his father. One who simply remains alive in Christian consciousness, following the regressive principles of yoga automatically becomes eligible to…”

The one who keeps practising — diligently, carefully, gratefully — receives the mercy. Not the one who runs off. Maharaj adds the saying that whoever fights and runs must fight again.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:38 (auto-transcript): “in other words he will be promoted to the kingdom means what a child should remain alive until his father leaves the planet and the child will be buried the father's property means one who does not give up his consciousness one who remain in Krishna consciousness practicing…”

A devotee tolerates the pain of growing. Others give up, asking why a merciful Krishna makes it so hard and why they cannot see his mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:01 (auto-transcript): “tolerates all the pains of growth. The pain of Growing in Christian consciousness. Educational who patiently wait and undergo the pain of growing in Christian consciousness. But that's giving it up. Ah, this is too much. If Christian is so messy, why is he making the process…”

We have no idea how deep our debt runs; a great devotee's prayer admits there is no sin he has not done millions of times. We cannot expect to clear it all at once.
