maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 24 · Brahma Says: I Don't Know

nodeData.topic: Day 24 · Brahma Says: I Don't Know
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.38 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. After a month of hearing grandfather Brahma, Maharaj says the one thing that matters now is application. In this verse Brahma admits that the Lord's opulences are beyond his mind, body and words, and Maharaj shows why 'I don't know' is so rare and so valuable — the self-confident are the easiest to cheat, while Krishna is conquered only by humble devotees. In the questions he defines humility, compares gurus to teachers with more degrees, and explains how to make amends after hurting someone. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj praises the devotees for listening to Brahma for a whole month like obedient children. Arjuna feared a battle that would kill the elders: the young have knowledge, but the elders have wisdom, and without them life loses its direction. — “The elders have wisdom.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:15 (auto-transcript): “so we continue getting wisdom realization from the brahma yes an obedient children obedient children should listen to the parents so all of you have not made a mistake listening to lord brahma for one month you have done the duty of an obedient student so you are glorified…”

Kali-yuga began when leaders fell — when Sringi cursed the king and the brahmanas, the head of society, failed. Our suffering today comes from having no heads to guide the hands. — “The head has to guide the hands.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:13 (auto-transcript): “That is the beginning of Kali Yuga. Kali Yuga begins when the leaders fell down, when no leaders. At the beginning of Kali Yuga, no leader. Sringi cursed the leader. Brahmanas fell down. Brahmanas are the head. So when the Brahmanas fail, what would happen? The head has to…”

In a cultured society the parents gather the children and share their realisations. Brahma, our grandfather, has been doing exactly that for us this month.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:43 (auto-transcript): “So all of you, all of you are doing the right thing, listening to our, our little Brahma, he's our grandfather, so Brahma is our grandfather, he is sharing his wisdom, this is the duty of the parents, with the culture, the parents call all the children together and sit down…”

Maharaj asks what matters most after a month of hearing. Among answers like transformation and prayer, the one he picks is application: without it, all we have heard is useless.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:34 (auto-transcript): “so for one month you have been hearing from our grandfather this is wonderful life now what is the most important thing in this one month we have listened to the brahma was the most important thing or the most important thing or listening to the grandma for one month what is…”

children.topic: Ghee on fire, not on ashes
children.note:
Hearing without practice is like pouring ghee on ashes. When we apply what we have heard, the ghee falls on fire and it blazes. — “the fire of bhakti will flame”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:53 (auto-transcript): “application. Application. What we have had for the whole month. Application. Without application, no results just like we have offered a blessing to ashes we'll get fire and for fire to burn in it to to the gear on fire not on ashes if you don't apply means we are adding G to…”

We have been trained and equipped with Brahma's wisdom; now, sword of knowledge in hand, we must cut our bondage. Then the result appears and the whole world feels the heat.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:07 (auto-transcript): “Swami said with the sword in hand we should do what caught the binding foresees knowledge knowledge so it means knowledge we have knowledge now we have been trained we have been equipped for lord brahma's wisdom now we have to apply it then the result will manifest the result…”

Brahma, concluding, lets others claim to know everything about Krishna; for himself he says the Lord's opulences are out of reach of his mind, body and words. The verse is read with two translations; the first is also quoted in the Caitanya-caritamrta.

children.topic: 'I don't know' — so hard to say
children.note:
Brahma's conclusion is that he does not know Krishna. Maharaj says few people can say these words; everyone thinks he knows, and that kind of knowing is foolishness. — “Not many people have these words.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:55 (auto-transcript): “It's the Brahma's conclusion. It's Brahma's conclusion. Krishna, I don't know much about you. That's the conclusion of the Brahma. I don't know. Very important. We were saying at that time that this is very, very difficult thing for people to say. I don't know. This is very…”

When Krishna praises Brahma's wisdom, Brahma answers with fear, humility and shame: he once thought he knew much, and Krishna has shown him he knows nothing. — “I was thinking that I know.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:34 (auto-transcript): “This verse is spoken out of fear, yes, humility, repentance, and shame, yes, shame. It's a shame. Brahma is a shame. A shame of what he did. I was thinking that I know. This is shame. I was thinking that I know. But now I know that I don't know anything. So Brahma is saying…”

To whom would a trader sell bad goods — a blind man or one who thinks himself clever? The blind man calls someone to check; the self-confident one checks with no one and is cheated easily. — “they would cheat him very easily because he think he knows”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:36 (auto-transcript): “demonstrated to me that I don't know anything. I mentioned the other day, if you remember, that the easiest people to to cheat the easiest you to cheat are those who think they know why they believe my father is so it's routine if you have a bad good to set if I have a bad…”

children.topic: A frog's croak, a drop of poison
children.note:
Brahma calls his words a frog's croaking that only invites the snake. Maharaj praises speaking concisely: a law book is huge yet takes us far from Krishna, while a small book of Krishna's glories is mighty — as one drop of poison is enough to kill.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:42 (auto-transcript): “will ask they will check yes because that Christian protest if that is so then why have you spoken all these words right if you're a fool how can you speak like this so in the country like this how Heidi how can you speak like this Brahmat's it came but who care what is the…”

Everything about Krishna is bewildering, and only a pure devotee cannot be fooled by him.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:10 (auto-transcript): “bewildering everything everything about Krishna is very bewildering everything only a pure devotee cannot be deceived to see by Krishna Krishna tried to hide from from under the ride did he succeed Chris I tried he tried his best and the supreme God had to hide from another…”

Krishna tried his best to hide from Srimati Radharani and failed: before her his disguise disappeared and he returned to his original Syamasundara form.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:15 (auto-transcript): “only a pure devotee cannot be deceived to see by Krishna Krishna tried to hide from from under the ride did he succeed Chris I tried he tried his best and the supreme God had to hide from another ride did he succeed he failed did he succeed he failed because I tried to hide…”

A devotee can tell Krishna: run if you like, you are locked in my heart and I hold the key. Demons, however, Krishna easily deceives — Kamsa saw him face to face and saw nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:01 (auto-transcript): “okay so you can run they would the best be at the Supreme God or see whatever you are running to you are locked up in my head so what can you go what can you go where do you have power to leave my heart do you have power to leave my heart you are locked up here see the key my…”

Quoting the Brahma-samhita, Maharaj says Krishna is very hard to reach for non-devotees, yet the unconquered Lord is conquered by his devotees. — “The unconquerable has become conquered by his”

🎙 Maharaj at 60:05 (auto-transcript): “Dula Ba, Adrula Ba Atma Bhaktou. It's very very difficult for non-devotees but for devotee Krishna is Ajito Jitapi, right? The unconquerable has become conquered by his devotees. Gorgobinda is very ecstatic, very ecstatic, very ecstatic, he is a devotee. So he said hmm no…”

Brahma's point is illustrated with two pastimes that defy logic.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:40 (auto-transcript): “he said hmm no grandma said hey master a butter when he's doing what's his name or the duty or the king was keeping much of a time when the name such a such a brat thank you such a brat yes such a brat such a branch or the food it was keeping Marcia the fish on the big, very…”

As Matsya, the Lord kept growing — from bowl to well to ocean — and begged the king not to put him in the sea. The one who protects everyone asked for protection.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:51 (auto-transcript): “or the duty or the king was keeping much of a time when the name such a such a brat thank you such a brat yes such a brat such a branch or the food it was keeping Marcia the fish on the big, very big bowl, big bowl. After some time the fish became bigger. So remove and put in…”

With demons Krishna never begs; he shows the strength of his arms. Killing Trinavarta, he says he is only a child who held the demon's neck in fear of falling — how can anyone blame him? — “I'm just a child.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:31 (auto-transcript): “Krishan did not do like that. Krishan did that to his devotees. To his devotees he did, were not to demons. For demons, Krishan said see. Did I see the strength of my arms? I was struggling with your death. Right? He didn't beg. Krishan did not beg for business as a demon.…”

Brahma's attitude should be ours. Otherwise we start admiring our own lectures; better to keep quiet and accept that we do not understand. — “we should always think ourselves insignificant”

🎙 Maharaj at 64:51 (auto-transcript): “me are totally insignificant Sri Brahma Kijai this is this this will be our consciousness we should always think ourselves insignificant insignificant otherwise we'll be thinking that ah did you hear that lecture I give yeah did you hear that lecture ah that is me what do you…”

children.topic: A tiny boy, a huge demon
children.note:
Brahma saw a small boy with food in his hand and mighty demons touching the sky; he could not understand Krishna's body, words or senses.

Krishna is understood only by his mercy, and that mercy comes when we are humble. Brahma is teaching us humility. — “the Brahma is teaching us humility”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:23 (auto-transcript): “senses I don't understand everything is beyond me only by your mercy can one understand you only by the nature of Krishna in other words we should be humble the Brahma is teaching us humility we should be humble so we humble when we are humble then they will help us to…”

Krishna's words need acaryas to explain them. Maharaj recalls the spiritual masters who teach sadhana-bhakti, raga-bhakti and prema-bhakti; one who has all three degrees is the eternal guru who guides us in Goloka.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:20 (auto-transcript): “say our challenge they need to explain so we need we're talking about spiritual master we explaining diversity yesterday yesterday if we said the the first day so we're explaining spiritual masters the spiritual masters we're explaining the spiritual master who will teach us…”

Krishna once told a devotee simply 'recite', and without instruction he recited prayers from the heart. He could do it because he had been trained — would we know what to recite? — “because they have been trained”

🎙 Maharaj at 70:21 (auto-transcript): “in Goloka right so one day Christian told one devotee recite you remember we did that as a side in Brunama did remember when they do what the case I say recite right it let it down it was because I told the duty recite recite if I tell you ever tell you but a guitar it is 66…”

Do not think chanting alone means you are ready to deal with Krishna. During the gopis' dance an ornament fell, and at one look from Vrinda Devi it was put back — could we serve like that? That needs training.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:25 (auto-transcript): “training so don't think that now I'm going back to God here please be careful she'll be careful she'll try to understand chant and go back to God yes but what are we chanting to go back to God has have we been trained how to deal with Krishna and Goloka by Kunta we trained…”

Questions after the host's writing reflection.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:20 (auto-transcript): “to the question and answers so in case any devotee has any questions or comments you may type it out in the chat box or raise your hand on zoom so Shri Tamati ji you may go ahead Hare Krishna Guru Maharaj Danvatrina my humble and respectful obeisance is on to you Guru Maharaj…”

Is speaking politely humility, or what is it really?

🎙 Maharaj at 88:39 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Guru Maharaj Danvatrina my humble and respectful obeisance is on to you Guru Maharaj you always say we have to be humble but exactly what is humility like someone might be talking very politely but But does that come under humility or means exactly what is…”

Prabhupada defines humility as not expecting honour from others.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:23 (auto-transcript): “So the prophet said, humility means one should not expect to be honoured by God. That is humility. Question 4.8.18, one should not look for honour, expect that. That is humility.”

Humility is not low self-esteem, nor the pride of being 'too humble' to sweep the floor — that is arrogance. It is a spiritual quality: not campaigning for glory. — “Think less of yourself, but not yourself less.”

🎙 Maharaj at 90:09 (auto-transcript): “said it means, as you put it, humility means what? Remember, not to think less, not to think less of oneself, but less of oneself. Think less of yourself, but not yourself less. It means what? Humility doesn't mean low self-esteem. It is not low self-esteem. It is not. At the”

children.topic: Q2 · Raga guru or prema guru?
children.note:
What is the difference between the guru who teaches raga-bhakti and the one who gives prema?

🎙 Maharaj at 92:17 (auto-transcript): “We have another question in the chat box from His Grace Matsya Prabhu ji. So Matsya Prabhu ji is asking from the class, Hare Krishna dear Guru Dev, please accept my humble obeisance is unto your lotus feet. What would be the difference between the Guru that teaches us Raga…”

Very simple: like professors, one has more degrees, knowledge and experience than another. A pure devotee goes on to be trained in Krishna's pastimes themselves. — “A professor has one degree, and a professor has two degrees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 92:54 (auto-transcript): “Very simple. Very simple. A professor has one degree, and a professor has two degrees. That's the difference. You have more degrees than me, that's all. children.topic: Poets while massaging, chanting in sleep
children.note:
Those who massage Krishna are also poets reciting his pastimes, not too hard and not too soft. Our own goal is to hear so fully that the chanting continues in dreams and we wake up chanting, as a devotee from Brazil shared.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:34 (auto-transcript): “That is why, when one becomes pure devotee, now you go and meet Krishna, where he is having his earthly pastures. We will go directly there, because that is the final touch. We will go there to get training from there to the verses. how to understand aiding cows with Krishna,…”

Hearing moulds our character, but can other methods also make us sincere and serious — and which matters more?

🎙 Maharaj at 98:29 (auto-transcript): “our daily experience all right yes please accept my humble obeisances uh you stress always on hearing keep on hearing so by hearing our character will be molded in the right direction yes but what if i will say i can there are other methods to become sincere and serious is it…”

These qualities depend on and complete each other; a sincere person must be serious and a serious one sincere. — “they are like husband and wife together”

🎙 Maharaj at 99:59 (auto-transcript): “you see all these words together all these all these qualities they are together they interdependent they complement each other all of them yes a person who is very sincere must be a serious and a serial duty must be a sincere person otherwise it doesn't it doesn't have any…”

children.topic: Q4 · Making amends after hurting someone
children.note:
After realising we hurt someone, how do we atone and help them feel loved again?

🎙 Maharaj at 103:52 (auto-transcript): “Prabhuji is saying, Hare Krishna, please accept my humble obeisances. After realizing that we have made a mistake hurt someone how can we properly atone for it what is the best way to help that person feel genuinely loved and cared for again according to the principles of…”

Go to the person and sincerely beg forgiveness — not with false humility — and ask for their blessing never to repeat it with anyone. The person is touched, we are purified, and everyone benefits. — “beg sincerely from the heart”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:10 (auto-transcript): “handled it with envy it will show so when when you have come to understanding what should i do i should go and beg the person who must go and beg the person beg sincerely from the heart not here artificially not not just because to show my false humility no sincerely we must…”

If we tolerate anger, false ego and insults while meditating on Krishna and guru, will we become free of them?

🎙 Maharaj at 107:01 (auto-transcript): “we have a last question from anushri mataji for today's class mataji is saying Hare Krishna dear Gurudev, our glories to Shla Prabhupada, our glories to Param Gurudev and our glories to you. Shla Gurudev, if we tolerate anger, false ego, insults and all such things while…”

The power to tolerate depends on the quality of our practice; with strong practice we tolerate and become purified. — “Definitely we'll become purified.”

maps.title: Brahma's Prayers · Day 25 · Giving the Universe Back

nodeData.topic: Day 25 · Giving the Universe Back
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.39 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Brahma asks Krishna's leave and offers back the universe he was only entrusted to manage — teaching us to stop claiming Krishna's property as our own. Maharaj shows Brahma's embarrassment through the image of a family meal spoilt, and Krishna's silence while Brahma talks on. He stresses finishing one's duty before moving on, and tells how Haridasa Thakura's previous lives were shaped by offences. In the questions he speaks on mindful service, making amends for offences to the guru, tulasi, discipline and Ekadasi. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma begs permission to leave, recognising Krishna as the knower and master of everything, and offers him this one universe. The verse is read with a second translation and the Krishna book passage on Brahma feeling out of place amid the simple love of Vrindavan.

Why would Brahma offer Krishna something that already belongs to him? To teach us: we too were made caretakers and foolishly claim Krishna's property as ours.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:58 (auto-transcript): “and yet i offered this one universal does it make sense for the drama to offer this something that doesn't belong to him to the corner christian is the owner of everything it was given to him to manage so it was a need of brahma offering it back to him there is a need not see…”

By mercy Brahma realises the universe is Krishna's alone and gives it back — not abandoning his service, but recognising Krishna's position.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:19 (auto-transcript): “it was given to him to manage so it was a need of brahma offering it back to him there is a need not see no brahma is teaching us how we should behave because we have the mentality to claim christian property as our own so here the brahma has been made fortunate so what you…”

Brahma created the universe but did not manufacture its ingredients, so he cannot claim it. We do the same with every little thing we receive — who gave it to you?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:20 (auto-transcript): “no one knows so brahma confirming that yes just because i created this universe does not mean that i am it master that is true because all the ingredients were given the ingredients were given to the brahma it didn't manufacture those ingredients this one is better yes”

children.topic: The builder hands over the key
children.note:
When an engineer finishes a building, he hands the key to the owner and leaves. That is what Brahma does with the universe, and what we should do. — “he give the key to the owner”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:16 (auto-transcript): “which are you seeing curtain the universe so what does it mean I own it it belongs to you and what we do if you can do the engineer finish construction building what they do he give the key to the owner a learner will take take it and leave the comfortably yeah that's what we…”

Brahma feels unfit to remain even a moment and asks to go to a place suited to a fallen soul — the conditioned world where the jivas live.

nodeData.topic: Day 26 · Obeisances As Long As the Sun Shines
nodeData.note: SB 10.14.40 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. In the last class of the series Brahma ends his prayers by offering obeisances to Krishna for as long as the universe lasts, even to his gunja beads and the humble arka plant. Maharaj explains why the material world is real but temporary, why the open atheist is less dangerous than the religious cheat (the cat swami), and why Brahma calls himself a rakshasa from Satyaloka — teaching us to check daily whether our activities please or disturb Krishna. In the questions he distinguishes the gopis' self-forgetfulness from ignorance, and humility from self-pity, and ends by blessing the devotees after the month of Purushottama. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Brahma's final verse glorifies Krishna as the joy of the Vrishnis, the friend of the earth, demigods, brahmanas and cows, and the destroyer of irreligion and demons, and offers obeisances for as long as the universe exists. Gathered on the last day of Purushottama, the devotees hear it with two translations.

Maharaj takes Brahma's words personally: as long as there is life in this body, obeisances go on at Krishna's lotus feet without stopping. Sanatana Gosvami says Brahma is here in the ecstasy of nama-sankirtana, calling out names that recall Krishna's pastimes.
